title: Unify prefetch handshake to minimize KV lock contention and simplify scheduler lifecycle
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Background: The prefetch handoff between the continuous batcher and the local KV cache currently uses multiple lock-protected stages. This design causes transient lock contention under bursty traffic and complicates scheduler shutdown and slot recycling. Goal: Replace the multi-stage handshake with a single lease-based prefetch protocol that is cancel-safe, reduces lock hold times, and makes scheduler lifecycle transitions deterministic. Constraints: No user-visible API changes; must remain compatible with Dedicated and Private deployments; avoid increasing memory usage by >10%. Success metrics: 30% reduction in tail latency under 95th percentile for 1-2s bursts, 40% drop in KV lock contention metrics, zero regressions in p99 cold-start latency.
acceptance_criteria: Implement lease-based prefetch protocol with documented state machine
Unit and integration tests covering lease renewal, cancellation, and scheduler quiesce
Load test showing >=30% reduction in 95th-percentile inference latency during burst traffic
Migration path for ongoing requests—no dropped in-flight sessions during rollout
Observability: new metrics for lease acquisitions/releases and a dashboard updating existing SLOs
